title: Layout frontmatter
description: Flat frontmatter of a layout hybrid MD in layouts/. Body sections: ## Elements, ## Accepts, ## Fill rules, ## Flow, ## Speaker notes. Element-table columns are documented in spec/schema.md.
$comment: Decision 2: flat frontmatter only, scalars and flat lists, no maps. Every layout file carries every key; use "-" or [] for empty.

title.$comment: Free text, no vocab. Read by scripts/build-html.mjs pageLabel() (it becomes the Canva page title) and displayed as the Layout column in bases/layouts.base.
title.description: Human name of the layout, e.g. "KPI Grid 2x3". Not an id: the machine-readable class is archetype.

family.$comment: Closed enum. Source of truth: spec/vocab/family.json. JSON Schema cannot load the vocab at runtime, so validate.mjs injects the enum from that file; keep this array in sync with it.
family.description: Top-level grouping; also the Canva family master this layout lives in.

archetype.$comment: Closed enum. Source of truth: spec/vocab/archetype.json. JSON Schema cannot load the vocab at runtime, so validate.mjs injects the enum from that file; keep this array in sync with it.
archetype.description: The layout class. broader in archetype.json must equal this file family.

variant.$comment: Closed enum. Source of truth: spec/vocab/variant.json. JSON Schema cannot load the vocab at runtime, so validate.mjs injects the enum from that file; keep this array in sync with it.
variant.description: Cut of the archetype: standard, dense or sparse.

flow_role.$comment: Closed enum. Source of truth: spec/vocab/flow_role.json. JSON Schema cannot load the vocab at runtime, so validate.mjs injects the enum from that file; keep this array in sync with it.
flow_role.description: Where this layout sits in a narrative.

content_shape.$comment: Closed enum. Source of truth: spec/vocab/content_shape.json. JSON Schema cannot load the vocab at runtime, so validate.mjs injects the enum from that file; keep this array in sync with it.
content_shape.description: Shapes of content this layout can host; a unit binds only if its shape is in this list.

density.description: Density level this layout is drawn for (research/03 §c).
density.$comment: Levels 1-5 map in order onto spec/vocab/density.json (cinematic, talk, briefing, consulting, slidedoc). The frontmatter key is numeric so Obsidian can sort and filter it as a Number property; validate.mjs resolves the level to the vocab entry.

info_units.description: Number of distinct information units the layout carries; at most 6 elements per slide (research/03 §c, PLOS rule 7).

min_items.description: Minimum count for the repeated role, from the archetype item range (research/03 §a, research/06 §c).

max_items.description: Maximum count for the repeated role. Must be >= min_items.

text_capacity_chars.description: Sum of maxChars over every element whose role has broader text_role in spec/vocab/element_role.json. Computed by validate.mjs; a mismatch is an error.

polish_cost.description: Design effort this layout needs (research/03 §d). The deck polish dial caps it: quick <= 2, standard <= 3, premium any.
polish_cost.$comment: Levels 1-5 map in order onto spec/vocab/polish.json (typography_only, type_primitives, chart_or_photo, curated_imagery, bespoke). The frontmatter key is numeric so Obsidian can sort and filter it as a Number property; validate.mjs resolves the level to the vocab entry.

slots_image.description: Count of picture and media elements.

fonts.description: Font families used, spelled as spec/fonts.json spells them.

fonts_native.description: True when every family in fonts has canva_native "yes" in spec/fonts.json.

pairing.description: Named title/body font pairing from spec/pairings.md.

brand.$comment: Closed enum. Source of truth: spec/vocab/brand.json. JSON Schema cannot load the vocab at runtime, so validate.mjs injects the enum from that file; keep this array in sync with it.
brand.description: alderman-ai for branded layouts, neutral for anything published to the public repo.

follows_well.description: Layout ids or archetype values that sit well before this one; used by the continuity score in match.mjs.

precedes_well.description: Layout ids or archetype values that sit well after this one.

tags.description: Free retrieval keywords. Not vocabulary-controlled; never used by the planner.

status.$comment: Closed enum. Source of truth: spec/vocab/status.json. JSON Schema cannot load the vocab at runtime, so validate.mjs injects the enum from that file; keep this array in sync with it.
status.description: Layout lifecycle. Subset of spec/vocab/status.json with broader layout_status.

origin.description: Where this layout came from: an intake contract, a harvested repo, or "-" for hand-authored. Repo-relative POSIX path, or "-" when not set.

accepts_schema.description: Path to the per-layout accepts file, spec/schema/layouts/<id>.json, validated against spec/schema/accepts.template.json. Repo-relative POSIX path, or "-" when not set.

canva_ops.description: Path to the generated build/canva-ops/<id>.json. Repo-relative POSIX path, or "-" when not set.

family_deck.description: Canva design id of the family master holding this layout as a page. Quoted string so PowerShell never coerces it to Int64 (research/06 §e). "-" when not uploaded.

family_page.description: Canva page id of this layout inside family_deck. Quoted string so PowerShell never coerces it to Int64 (research/06 §e). "-" when not uploaded.

canva_locators.description: Per-element Canva locator ids (PBxxx-LByyy) in element-table order, written back by index.mjs.
